%% Preamble additions for a DRLD whose generated parts come from pymetis -- generated, do not edit
%% Hand-written cards: the DRLD's recipedef / datastructdef on an orange background.
\newenvironment{handrecipedef}
{\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,enhanced jigsaw,colback=orange!20,colframe=orange!60!black]%
    \begin{longtable*}{p{0.24\hsize}p{0.69\hsize}}}
{   \end{longtable*}%
  \end{tcolorbox}}
\newenvironment{handdatastructdef}
{\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,enhanced jigsaw,colback=orange!20,colframe=orange!60!black]%
    \begin{longtable*}{p{0.97\hsize}}}
{   \end{longtable*}%
  \end{tcolorbox}}
%% A flag above a hand-written part: \notgenerated{no such recipe in pymetis}
\newcommand{\notgenerated}[1]{%
  \begin{tcolorbox}[colback=orange!20,colframe=orange!60!black,boxrule=0.4pt,left=2pt,right=2pt,top=1pt,bottom=1pt]%
    \small\textbf{Hand-written:} #1 (not generated by pymetis)%
  \end{tcolorbox}}
